title: O.P.
html_source: For “ordinary person” or “ordinary people”. It is a play on George William Russell’s pseudonym A.E. (sometimes AE).

anchor.prefix: p. The Christ with the bridesister, moisture of light, born of an ensouled virgin, repentant sophia, departed to the plane of buddhi. The life esoteric is not for ordinary person.
anchor.suffix:
must work off bad karma first. Mrs Cooper Oakley once glimpsed our very illustrious sister H.P.B.'s elemental.
